notes: Bucket total 18 (hard). Max competency floor is hard (C-85b852b). Five distinct deliverables must all succeed: link.py coalesces per-module LLVM IR into one linkable all.bc that resolves a genuine cross-module call (C-0c70052d) and carries debug metadata from a -g rebuild of the C source (C-992ec77f); elf.py parses ELF32/ELF64 header + section-header tables honoring endianness and emits an exact address->32-bit-word JSON (C-6c1e4526, C-e1e3902d); sym.py runs a symbolic engine that covers every branch both true and false with generated concrete cases (C-cb07fa86); solver.py accepts a quantifier-free bit-vector SMT-LIB proof-of-work query on stdin and returns a verdict with zero exit code (C-5c5377bf). tool_breadth spans clang/llvm-link/llvm-dis/llvm-dwarfdump, raw ELF binary parsing, an expression parser for the symbolic conditions, and z3 SMT solving. reasoning_depth is high: deriving ELF field offsets/endianness, rebuilding the C source with -g so the IR carries debug metadata, and a correct branch-covering search. hidden_case_generalization is high because the verifier also runs link.py on an unrelated IR pair and elf.py on two freshly-compiled ELF64 binaries, feeds a sat + unsat SMT query pair (an agent that hard-codes 'sat' fails the unsat case), and runs sym.py on a 3-variable/3-gate module. quantitative_correctness covers exact word decoding and JSON equality.
